title: Cross-validate: same key -> same address in all impls
notes:
2026-08-25 parity audit: Python cross-corpus address test added and green (124 IPv6/address tests; Ruff/MyPy; generator freshness). Rust lichen-core yggdrasil_addr_vectors 3/3 and no_std check green. BLOCKER: C declares/calls lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519 but rg finds no C implementation under lichen/subsys. Existing link_crypto consumer cannot compile at origin/main a72dbaf7b7 due unrelated Kconfig loop (LICHEN_COAP_KEYS/ZCBOR), duplicate SCHC declarations, stale Schnorr signatures/fakes/TDMA APIs; build-only Kconfig workaround got through configuration and exposed those compile failures. Production C/identity files were explicitly read-only for this bead, so all-implementation parity cannot be completed or closed.
2026-08-26 duplicate re-evaluation: this bead is functionally identical to project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.11.1.5 (same Ed25519 key -> IID/link-local/native 0200::/8 parity across Python/Rust/C). The live canonical Python/Rust gates were run immediately under .11.1.5 and are green: Python test_key_address_cross_impl_vectors.py 7 passed; Rust ipv6_address_vectors 4 passed and yggdrasil_addr_vectors 3 passed. C blocker remains: repository-wide search finds only the declaration lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/link_ctx.h:341 and callers in l2/ipv6_addr.c:362 plus app_identity/app_identity.c:125/:251; no C definition of lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519 exists. Therefore link_crypto's hard-coded three-vector wrapper test cannot link as a production C parity consumer. Python/Rust test files are also currently shared dirty/active, so no redundant edits were made. Leave open/unclaimed alongside .11.1.5 until the C implementation exists and its canonical vector test builds/runs green; then converge/deduplicate the two beads. No files modified and no duplicate test rerun.
2026-08-27 convergence validation: the prior C blocker is resolved by lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519 plus the focused host consumer. Existing direct parity coverage is sufficient: Python cross-corpus/shared-vector suite 7/7 PASS; Rust ipv6_address_vectors 4/4 and yggdrasil_addr_vectors 3/3 PASS; Zephyr/C pubkey_to_iid Werror+UBSan host suite 1/1 PASS. The same zero, SHA-256-empty anchor, and asymmetric RFC8032 Ed25519 public keys produce byte-exact SHA-512 IID, fe80:: link-local, and native 0200::/8 /128 outputs; Python/Rust also consume every key-derived identity vector and malformed-length edges. git diff --check PASS. No files changed for this bead; short_addr_iid untouched.
close_reason: Validated byte-exact Ed25519 address parity across Python, Rust, and Zephyr/C
